prompt.project_info: Create a low-angle high-fashion portrait in a bright architectural white studio with a voluminous golden faux-fur coat.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional platinum-blonde woman with shoulder-length soft waves, light blue-gray eyes, natural minimal makeup and nude-pink lips, seated in a comfortable crouch with knees together, wrapped in an oversized golden-yellow shaggy faux-fur coat covering the torso, wearing white ankle-strap heels.
prompt.composition_elements: 3:4 low-angle full-body shot, white walls, ceiling beams and architectural studio lines, dramatic perspective, fur and skin texture contrasted.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused professional studio light, clean bright highlights, minimal shadows, commanding editorial atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: High-fashion photography, realistic faux-fur strands, skin and heels, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-fashion 3:4 editorial portrait of a clearly adult fictional platinum-blonde woman with shoulder-length soft waves, light blue-gray eyes and natural minimal makeup, seated comfortably in a crouch with knees together, wrapped in an oversized golden-yellow shaggy faux-fur coat covering the torso, white ankle-strap heels, bright architectural white studio, low-angle dramatic perspective, soft diffused light, luxurious realistic fur and skin texture, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, exposed intimate areas, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, real fur, plastic skin, over-smooth, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed
